title: 未建造的电缆仍能连接电力，游戏认为电缆已存在。
description: 未建造的电缆仍能连接电力，游戏认为电缆已存在。
evidence: There was a power glitch when i ran unbuilt cable, it still connected the power. The game thought those cables existed when they were not built yet.
